path.description: RFC 9535 JSONPath to the component the message refers to.

action.description: Optional rendering action the platform SHOULD perform to fulfill this message. When present on an info message, the action is non-blocking: the platform MAY perform it in the background while checkout remains in 'ready_for_complete', and SHOULD resubmit on the same path once the action completes. Typical use: collecting risk or abuse signals (e.g., 3DS device data collection, hidden bot-detection probes) where 'path' indicates the signal the business expects to be populated. Platforms that cannot render the action MAY ignore it; 'content' remains the authoritative description.
